title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E7 — Knight Sting
Michael infiltrates an embassy to investigate foreign diplomats and their plans to sell a stolen canister of deadly bacteria.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 — Many Happy Returns
Michael and KITT battle a military hovercraft hijacked for sale to a weaponeer.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E9 — Women!
An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E10 — Dinner Date
DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E11 — Musical Mania
Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E12 — Helpful
An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E13 — Drivers
An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E14 — School Days
The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E15 — The Professor
Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E16 — Syndrome
Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E17 — Honest
Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E18 — Seance
A woman believes her dead sister is the cause of accidents in her home; a man is trapped underwater in his car with the doors jammed.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E8 — Blood, Sweat and Cheers
B.A. drives in a stock car race to prevent Hannibal's nephew (Ken Olandt) being run off the track by thugs; guest Stuart Whitman.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E9 — Mind Games
Pardoned Face's book-promotion TV tour hits a snag when a Viet Cong general seeks revenge for his jilted daughter.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E10 — There Goes the Neighborhood
The team conceals in suburbia a rock singer threatened by terrorists, until a nosy neighbor blows the whistle.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E9 — Knight Racer
A hateful man (William Windom) seeks revenge against the husband (John Crawford) of his former lover by sabotaging his race car. With David Hasselhoff, Jourdan Fremin, Norbert Weisser.
